original_commits.message:
feat(web): WebAssembly port of the normal app

Build HeavyMach for the browser with Emscripten. Sources/Core compiles unchanged;
Sources/Web translates the iOS platform layer (game view, menus, HUD, media,
renderer, audio) to C++ with WebGL2, Emscripten OpenAL, Pointer/Keyboard/
DeviceMotion events and an IDBFS save. Web/ holds the CMake build, the shell,
an asset packager that splits data files under 20 MiB, and a headless Chrome
smoke test. Windows taller than 4:3 keep the iPad 480x360 canvas and letterbox.

Deployed as a test to https://fastutle.com/game/heavy_mach/ (fastutle-site 0be8788).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(web): add Shilka/Tunguska (GroundAA) to the web build

Build GroundAA.cpp, call addGroundAAExpansion on data load, crop the shared
GAA source sheets and resize once to the logical size in Media::image like
HMMedia, and prepare every GroundAA frame before combat. The v0.14 HUD editor
is not ported yet; the web keeps the default HUD and three-button pause menu.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(web): tilt permission, full screen and 30 Hz pacing on iPad

iPad report: browser bars crop the game, the tank cannot move, the game is slow.
Touch taps now request DeviceMotion permission and full screen on pointerup,
where iOS grants user activation, and retry after an error. A web app manifest
and home-screen meta tags open the game without bars. Display callbacks at
30 Hz advance up to round(interval/tick) due ticks, so the game keeps 60 ticks
per second; 60 Hz stays one tick per callback. ?fps=30 emulates the slow case.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(web): iOS motion prompt, sensor sign and orientation (iPad verified)

Checked on iPad mini 6 Safari through the remote Web Inspector:
- requestFullscreen in the same tap hid the motion prompt; the first tap now
  asks for motion only, a pending prompt retries after 10 s, and a granted
  permission is restored on load without a tap.
- iOS WebKit reports accelerationIncludingGravity with the CoreMotion sign
  (landscape, device +X up: x -9.29); keep it, negate only the spec sign.
- iPadOS reports screen.orientation.angle 0 in landscape; read
  window.orientation first (90 = LandscapeRight).
Tilting right moves right, left moves left; combat runs at 60 ticks/s.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(web): record fastutle.com deployment and iPad live check

fastutle-site 0be8788..8f09692. The live index.html matches the verified local
build; iPad Safari loads it at 60.2 ticks/s and the headless flow passes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(web): port the v0.14 HUD layout editor

HUD drawing (WebGameHUD): per-group transforms, rail regions with riveted end
caps and the upper trim, the four-row pause menu with SET GAME UI (104) built
from GameMenuSub.png letters, button receivers captured per touch. Media and
GLRenderer gain drawRegion. WebHUDEditor.inc translates HMHUDEditor.inc: entry
from the pause menu, mission selection or an invalid layout; drag, Tab, arrows
and Esc; frozen game time; the Stage01 sample scene; APPLY writes
/persist/HUDLayoutV1-web.json atomically and syncs IndexedDB. The UIKit tool
panel becomes DOM buttons drawn from the game-decoded Common_Btn_OK.png (CgBI).
Web/tests/hud-editor.mjs covers entry, drag, apply, reload and reset.
Also fixes the ?fps= test regex (\d was escaped away; the earlier 30 Hz run
was really 60 Hz). No cheat web build (user decision).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(web): record Chrome, ego lite and Safari desktop checks

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(web): keep the spec motion sign on Android Chrome

Android Chrome 156 also exposes DeviceMotionEvent.requestPermission, so the
previous check gave Android the iOS sign and inverted tilt (same landscape:
iPad x -9.29, Lenovo TB322FC x +9.30). Identify Apple mobile WebKit by UA
(iPhone/iPad/iPod, or Macintosh with touch points) instead.
Checked on the Android pad: both landscapes move toward the tilted side,
full screen on the first tap, 59.9 ticks/s on a 120 Hz display, jump, touch
fire and the HUD editor with touch.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(web): hold in portrait and continue back in landscape

User decision: a phone or tablet passing through portrait while it is turned
no longer opens the pause menu. hm_active now takes 2 for portrait only: time,
input and sound stop, and landscape continues the game. Hidden tab, blur and
pagehide keep the iOS resign-active pause, also when they arrive during a hold.
Web/tests/orientation-hold.mjs covers hold, resume and blur during a hold.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
